intendedInstrument.rationale: The repository models NSE equity intraday execution (kind: 'EQ', productType: 'INTRADAY'), and the engine refuses spot-index orders ('route orders via NIFTY/BANKNIFTY NFO futures'), so equity is the declared trading intent.

segmentInventory.why: Two 2020 tapes only, no licence (all rights reserved), multiple symbols interleaved without per-symbol separation (grade F). They cannot support a per-strategy equity study, and they may not be redistributed.

segmentInventory.volume: absent by construction (index series publishes zero volume)
segmentInventory.contractSpec: not applicable — a spot index is a reference series, not a contract
segmentInventory.why: This is the only multi-year series available. It supports a mechanical proxy study, not validation of an equity strategy: the price path is not the traded instrument, and the engine itself rejects spot-index orders.

segmentInventory.contractSpec: UNVERIFIED — no contract master or lot size verified in this environment
segmentInventory.why: No futures price series exists in the repository and the lot-size/expiry basis is unverified, so a futures study cannot be run honestly.
No option chains, strikes, expiries or IV surfaces are present; no strategy in the registry is an options strategy.
